stemMd: Small crates hold 8 units and large crates hold 15. A shipment uses 10 crates and contains 115 units. How many large crates are used?
explanationMd: If all ten crates were small they would hold 80 units. Each large replacement adds 7, and 35 extra units require 35/7=5 large crates.
